policy.constructedResponse: recommended in maths, physics, chemistry and biology; Computing's contract does not permit this kind, so its written explanations are assessed through short-answer items with marking criteria
policy.multipleChoice: generated retrieval practice; recorded as a separate surface from authored items
policy.numerical: the lesson's worked examples or guided practice teach a calculation; a quantitative subject alone is not enough
policy.graph: the lesson teaches a graph/chart or names axes/gradient; present when an assessment plots or reads one, including a prose item that reads a named chart/graph
policy.practical: an experiment representation or explicit plan/measure/investigate language; present only when an assessment asks the learner to plan or measure
policy.diagram: a diagram is taught AND the lesson asks for labelling/structure; present only when an assessment asks for one
policy.debugging: computing lessons that teach debugging; present only when an assessment asks the learner to debug or trace a fault
policy.optional: gap-fill, matching, ordering and extra structured forms are useful but not compulsory
